sentence: On 570 Spanish manufacturing firms, Vaillant et al. find that firms using AI platforms show more cooperative and capability-building behavior along the solution delivery process
passage: [Vaillant et al. (2025), abstract] "Data collected from 570 Spanish manufacturing firms in 2023 reveals that firms utilizing AI platforms exhibit greater cooperative and situating capability-building behavior during the problem identification and solution implementation stages."

gemini.note: The passage specifies the 'problem identification and solution implementation stages', which the sentence inaccurately generalizes or shifts to 'along the solution delivery process'.
